## Summary

- Continuous microphone and computer playback capture into local mono Opus files on macOS 14.2 and later.
- Ordered TOML microphone preferences with wildcard matching, global exclusions, and automatic input switching while preserving the active recording.
- Hourly rotation with nanosecond timestamp filenames, daily JSON diagnostics, capture recovery, and launchd supervision configuration.
- Native Apple Silicon and Intel executables with statically linked codecs, an embedded usage reference, and archive checksums.

Executables are ad-hoc signed; they are not Developer ID signed or notarized. Transcription, VAD, and calendar integration are not included.
